entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse you sold me. It's a complete piece of junk.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference that it should be usable! This thing is so `confusing` and `hard to use`. The interface is a nightmare. I `expected more` for the price I paid. I even tried reading the `user manual` and it was no help at all.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize that the device isn't meeting your expectations. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your full name, please?

It's Michael Chen. Look, don't waste my time trying to 'educate' me. I want a return label and my money back. Now. If you can't do that, get me your manager. I am not playing games and I will leave a review on every single website about this.

I understand your position, Mr. Chen. There's no need to speak with a manager, I can handle this for you. I see your order here, delivered 39 days ago. Let me just check our official return policy for you. One moment.
You'd better. I'm not paying for a high-tech paperweight.
Okay, I've just consulted our Knowledge Base. It states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 39, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Wait, really? So you're just... going to take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I am generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you right now and I've just sent it to the email address we have on file. Simply package the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, affix the label, and drop it at any post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item.
Oh. Okay. Well, that's... that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
